scope: single-A100 synthetic TP8 per-rank FusedMoE; not a chain or service score
derivation: Select named JSON record kinds from raw; timing summaries are copied verbatim from the SHA-identified benchmark and reproducible from timing_round records.
notes: SM clocks varied 1320-1395 MHz in timing telemetry; no claim of fixed clocks.
CUDA graph pools are independent; all-arm resident memory is not a per-arm saving.
Down enabled at8192/16384 and correctly retained native config at8191/16385.
Actual W2 activation and reduction raw BF16 bits matched in active cases; reduction exact in all4.
Reduction-only full-layer increment is not established by these data.
